context.//bootstrapQualifier: Deploys through the scoped tool0001 bootstrap. Ben's ToolKitDeveloper policy explicitly denies the default cdk-hnb659fds-* roles, so without this line the first deploy fails with an AssumeRole error that looks like a credentials problem. Do not change or remove.
context.//: ----- VLG settings. Nothing below is a secret. See DEPLOY_RUNBOOK.md -----
context.//domain: The subdomain VlgSite answers to. Empty = serve on the *.cloudfront.net name only. Goes together with certArn.
context.//certArn: The shared *.geniusdrive.com wildcard certificate (us-east-1), already issued, valid to 16 Mar 2027. Do not request a new one.
context.//mailDomain: The already-verified SES domain. VlgMail REFERENCES it and must never declare it: the identity belongs to the live SmomaMail stack (same pattern as K1x PmtcMail).
context.//sender: From address. Needs no mailbox; SES verifies the domain, not the mailbox.
context.//replyTo: Where a reply to the report goes. Must be a real mailbox. Keep it on Ben until go-live, then repoint and redeploy VlgMail.
context.//notify: Where bounce/complaint/reject alerts go. AWS sends a confirmation email on first deploy that must be clicked (check spam).
context.//bcc: Blind copy on every report, comma-separated. Empty = nobody.
